title: Without reports access, Sales By Customer is not listed and cannot open
refs: SV-8600 (SBC spec Story 1 S1-N1 — permission model RULED to the ordinary reports access by Chris Ward answer 2026-07-31 Q4=A; the build still ships a dedicated permission)
custom_preconds:
1. A test user exists whose role does NOT have reports access (use/create a ZZAUTOTEST role; restore afterwards).
2. You know the report's direct page address (copy it from a permitted session first).
3. You are signed in as the unpermitted user.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports area and look through the left-side navigation.
2. Paste the report's direct page address into the browser and try to open it.
custom_expected:
1. "Sales By Customer" does not appear in the Reports navigation.
2. Opening the report by direct link does not show the report (the application blocks it with its standard access-denied handling).
3. The gate is the ordinary reports access — there is no separate Sales By Customer permission to remove.
